dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent concave curvature from the apex to the basal insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Apex is acute and terminates in a small rounded pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin rises at a steep, approximately 55-degree angle relative to the dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The vertical height of the fin is approximately 1.1 times its visible longitudinal base width.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: The melon presents a smooth, moderate convex arc with a consistent radius leading to the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Rostrum is short and thick, with a length-to-thickness ratio of approximately 2:1.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: A well-defined notch is visible where the melon slope meets the rostrum at an obtuse angle of approximately 135 degrees.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple faint, linear depigmented rake marks are visible on the melon and the mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: A dark dorsal cape is clearly visible, providing a distinct color contrast against the lighter ventral and lateral regions.
